notes: Japan-market page (nintendo.co.jp), model CTR-001. Axis mapping: Nintendo lists 縦74mm×横134mm×厚さ21mm; height=横134 (long axis), width=縦74, depth=厚さ21 — Nintendo's own label for the long axis is 'width' (横). Closed/folded state as stated (折りたたみ時), which is also the source for hinge.type=clamshell; open state not published, left null. Nintendo gives these three figures as whole millimetres, so no extra precision has been added. TOP SCREEN / AUTOSTEREOSCOPIC 3D: recorded literally as Nintendo states it — 横800ドット×縦240ドット, i.e. [800,240], aspect 10:3. Nintendo's own gloss on the same line: 横800ドットを左目用・右目用にそれぞれ400ドット割り当てることで立体表現が可能 ('the 800 horizontal dots are allocated 400 each to the left and right eye, enabling stereoscopic display'), so the per-eye image is 400x240 (5:3) and the panel is a parallax-barrier autostereoscopic 裸眼立体視 wide LCD. The 800x240 figure is the panel's real dot count, not a marketing doubling. ACTIVE AREA IS PUBLISHED, NOT DERIVED: Nintendo prints the active area in millimetres inline with each diagonal (横76.8mm×縦46.08mm top, 横61.44mm×縦46.08mm bottom), so active_area_mm is quoted, and 'derived' is set FALSE here deliberately — marking published values as derived would misreport their provenance. Both displays are LCD; the bottom adds touch input. aspect strings are the exact reduction of the sourced resolutions, not an independent measurement. refresh_hz, materials, corner_radius, depth_at_hinge: not published, null. controls[].position null — Nintendo lists the controls but not their placement; the 3D depth slider (3Dボリューム), HOME button, wireless switch and power button are listed by Nintendo under その他入力 and have no matching enum kind. ports: game card slot, FULL-SIZE SD card slot, charging terminal and AC adapter connector are omitted (no matching enum kind; the SD slot is not microSD); Nintendo does not state the headphone jack's 3.5 mm diameter. released = Japan launch; other regions not sourced from a Nintendo page. announced: no Nintendo announcement release fetched, left null.
